meta.title: Metapharsic EHR Executive Trust Mood Board
meta.subtitle: Premium, calm, useful futurism for an AI-enabled clinic command-center campaign.

brief.theme: Metapharsic Lifesciences EHR as a modern clinic command center.
brief.goal: Create a premium campaign visual world that makes clinical and executive buyers feel focused, confident, and able to trust a sophisticated EHR platform.
brief.audience: Clinic owners, administrators, physicians, and operational leaders evaluating an AI-assisted EHR MVP.
brand_inputs: Next.js EHR product with patient management, voice workflows, prescriptions, clinical dashboards, documents, predictive timeline, genomics, digital twin, and admin views
brief.palette_direction: Clean whites, warm off-white surfaces, pale glass, graphite, controlled clinical blue, desaturated green, and small amber highlights.
brief.emotional_register: Premium focus, calm confidence, executive trust, warm usefulness, futurist minimalism.
visual_principles: single visual reference image per tile
context_signals: repository describes the product as a clinic digital command center
demo/MVP stage should feel advanced while staying honest and credible
clinical safety and operational clarity matter more than spectacle

audience_cues: clinical staff using calm AI assistance

items.title: Executive Clinic Worktable
items.caption: A premium decision table where clinical leadership reviews operations with calm focus.
items.source: Inferred from EHR command-center campaign brief
items.motif: warm work surface, glass interface, clinical planning
items.palette: warm ivory, graphite, pale blue, soft daylight
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of a premium clinic leadership worktable in soft daylight, two or three professionals partly visible from shoulders and hands only, reviewing a translucent glass-like digital interface hovering low over a warm matte work surface, abstract charts and patient-flow shapes with no readable text, quiet medical materials, calm confident mood, executive trust, warm useful futurist minimalism, clean white clinic background, realistic photography, shallow depth of field. No logos, no readable text, no patient identifiers, no collage, no grid, no contact sheet, no split panels.
